Method of Attack: Phishing kit allowing collection of stolen user data using Telegram bots
Sending stolen data collected from phishing sites to Google Forms via POST requests
Double-dipping by adding code that copies stolen data stream to developer's network host
Hiding web shells in code for remote access
Impacted Systems: Online services (online tools to view documents, online shopping, streaming services)
Users of Microsoft, PayPal, Google, and Yahoo products
Attack Vector: Exfiltration of stolen data via email, Google Forms, and Telegram bots
